comment: Parameter-provenance ledger (SHSD program §13). Every numeric parameter in production code is classified: learned | hyperparameter | mathematical | engineering. Unclassified constants are defects. Per-run configuration values carry their provenance through experiment cards and resolved.toml; this ledger covers constants living in code. Stage reports list every change to this file.

entries.name: exploration_epsilon
entries.selection: 3 eps x 3 seeds calibration, Phase 3 (D018): 0.10 most reliable exact-strategy recovery
entries.notes: frozen for the Program-1 recipe; SHSD reuses only for trajectory diversity where configured per run

entries.name: replay_generations
entries.selection: D016: current-gen-only training forgot measurably; one fixed FIFO window

entries.name: learning_rate
entries.selection: D011 chosen default; Phase 2 sweeps monotone and seed-stable, so no tuning experiment

entries.name: score_win
entries.selection: D006: forced win at ply p scores 32000 - p; representational constant

entries.name: score_terminal_bound
entries.selection: D006: |score| above this proves a terminal result

entries.name: score_eval_max
entries.selection: D006/D019: leaf evaluations clamp to +-1000; leaf = round(1000*(P(win)-P(loss)))

entries.name: selfplay_tt_log2
entries.selection: memory bound per worker (~2 MB); compute_strength_profile.md documents playing RSS

entries.name: solve_tt_log2
entries.selection: single-process solve runs afford a larger table

entries.name: promotion_tolerance
entries.selection: D017: strict rule halted on metric jitter at plateau

entries.name: match_gate_confidence
entries.selection: D021 promote on LCB95>0.5; D030 strike on UCB95<0.5 (symmetric proof requirement)

entries.name: deadline_check_interval
entries.selection: D025: model evaluators cost ~0.2 ms/node; 4096 lost every game on time

entries.name: eval_thin_salt
entries.selection: arbitrary constant separating thinning stream from split stream (D029); no strategic content

entries.name: sample_salt
entries.selection: arbitrary constant separating relabel sampling from split/thinning streams; no strategic content

entries.name: fit_train_salt
entries.selection: arbitrary constant; smallest-hash selection makes data-ladder subsets nested (§48.5); no strategic content

entries.name: labelling_max_depth
entries.selection: safety bound matching training/self-play searches; iterative deepening stops on node budget first
